policy.title: Rental & Deposit Policies
policy.subtitle: Detailed guidelines on security deposit, delivery, garment care, and incident fees at Chickie Studio.

deposit.title: 1. Security Deposit & Reservations
deposit.desc: To ensure your outfits and cameras are reserved exclusively for your shooting day, please complete deposit via one of the following methods:
deposit.option1Desc: Deposit 50% - 100% of the listed value of the outfit or equipment.
deposit.option2Title: Leave government ID at the studio:
deposit.option2Desc: Present your original national ID card or student ID card when picking up directly at our showroom.
deposit.refundDesc: Chickie Studio refunds 100% of your security deposit via bank transfer within 1 - 2 business hours after receiving and verifying item condition.

care.title: 2. Garment Care & Preservation Guidelines
care.desc: Our collection primarily consists of raw silk, hand-embroidered lace, and premium satin. Please note:
care.dont1: DO NOT machine wash, use strong bleach, or iron at high temperatures at home.
care.dont2: DO NOT spray high-alcohol perfumes directly onto silk or lace fabrics.
care.dont3: Keep away from cigarette ashes, birthday candles, sparklers, and sharp objects.
care.dont4: Do not alter stitches, tamper with seams, or use safety pins that pierce delicate fibers.
care.doDesc: Every garment returned undergoes professional eco-friendly dry cleaning and UV sterilization. You never need to wash items before returning.

late.title: 3. Return Hours & Overdue Surcharges
late.desc: Official return cutoff time: Before 21:00 on the final rental date specified in your booking.
late.rule1Desc: Surcharge of 50,000 VND / hour to support urgent turnaround for next appointments.
late.rule2Desc: Charged 100% of standard one-day rental rate.
late.notice: If you wish to extend your rental period, please inform our team at least 12 hours in advance to check item availability.

damage.title: 4. Damage & Loss Compensation Fee Schedule
damage.desc: We understand accidents happen. Compensation fees reflect direct atelier restoration costs:
damage.row1Type: Loose button, unraveled hem, minor zipper slip
damage.row2Type: Mud splatters, food/lipstick stains washable by dry clean
damage.row3Type: Small tear under 3cm, minor thread pull
damage.row4Type: Burn holes from cigarettes, large tears, indelible paint/ink

cancellation.title: 5. Rescheduling & Cancellation Policy
cancellation.desc: Chickie offers maximum flexibility for your photography shoots:
cancellation.freeChange: Complimentary Rescheduling: Notify us at least 24 hours in advance in case of severe weather or itinerary changes.
cancellation.cancelBefore48h: Cancellation prior to 48 hours: 100% security deposit refund.
cancellation.cancelWithin48h: Cancellation within 48 hours: Deposit converted into a flexible store voucher valid for 60 days.

about.title: About Chickie Studio
about.subtitle: Where every lady finds her signature gown to celebrate her brightest, most unforgettable milestones.
about.storyP1: Founded with a passion for designer boutique fashion, Chickie was born to empower modern women, graduates, and travelers to look stunning on their special days without spending millions to buy a dress worn only once.
about.storyP2: At Chickie Studio, every design—from evening gowns to romantic picnic dresses and modern graduation Ao Dai—is curated with premium textiles, tailored silhouettes, and maintained to pristine studio standards.
about.valuesSubtitle: Four foundational pillars guiding Chickie Studio every day
about.value1Desc: Carefully selected mulberry silk, brocade, and soft chiffon ensuring breathability and structure during outdoor photoshoots.
about.value2Desc: Patterned specifically for Vietnamese silhouettes, with gentle waist cinch adjustments for effortless confidence.
about.value3Desc: 100% of returned garments undergo organic essential oil dry cleaning and UV sanitization before protective packaging.
about.value4Desc: Thoughtful styling consultations, complimentary accessory pairings, and flexible weather rescheduling.
about.showroomDesc: A warm studio atmosphere featuring full-length backlit mirrors and spacious fitting rooms awaits your visit.
